findings.label: normalize->REQ-11 mapping is slightly loose
findings.detail: tests/README.md maps 'normalize yields unit length' to REQ-11, and the property now treats len < 1e-150 as vacuously passing. This narrows the asserted domain but still covers every value the app produces; the carve-out is a documented IEEE-754 boundary call, not a weakening of production code. No change required.

findings.label: Merge cascade is per-frame by design
findings.detail: resolveMerges merges each surviving body with later overlapping bodies in a single linear pass; a body produced by a merge is re-tested only on the next frame. The plan explicitly specifies this ('a merged body can cascade next frame'), and REQ-10 only requires count preservation on non-overlapping input, which holds. No change required.
